entry_rules.CONFIRMED: Exact TechnicalSwing: two closes above first30m range, relative return>0, same-slot RVOL20>1; decision60m+1s, next5m open.
entry_rules.MOM3_Z0: Use the last3 COMPLETE prior sessions' log(close/open), excluding overnight. Score=sample mean*sqrt(window)/sample SD, strictly above0.0; degenerate/nonfinite dispersion fails closed. Select highest score, lexical symbol tie. No market/world/regime labels. Initial stop distance=prior20-session mean true range. Decide at open+5minutes+1second; native IOC entry at open+10minutes. At most one nomination per rule per session. Score is a feature, not a significance test.

entry_rules.QUALITY: CONFIRMED; RVOL<=3; close extension above range<=0.6*prior20d ATR; prior30d return>0 and prior daily MACD(12,26,9) histogram>0. EMA initialized on first of exactly50 previous daily closes. All daily values strictly prior session.
entry_rules.RETEST: At90m+1s: breakout during30-60m; last30m low revisits within0.15*prior20d ATR of range high without falling below range low; lasttwo closes above range; positive relative return; RVOL last10m in[0.8,3]; prior30d return>0. Next5m entry.

exit_rules.FAST24: Native targets; after6 elapsedh with peak completed-close gain<0.5R and close<=entry, exit next open; max24h.
exit_rules.HOLD24: Initial protective stop and24h calendar deadline; no targets, partials or trailing.
exit_rules.HOLD72: Initial protective stop and72h calendar deadline; no targets, partials or trailing.
exit_rules.NATIVE72: Exact native 25% at1.5R/25% at3R and causal trailing; max72h.
exit_rules.NATIVE_QUEUE72: Exact native targets, quantities, trailing function and72h; ONLY preserve pending received stop updates in a queue.
exit_rules.PROTECT48: Native targets; after completed close reaches1R, protect entry adjusted for exit friction and two commissions, retain75% of peak close profit, trailing distance1R. Pending-stop queue preserves received updates; max48h.
exit_rules.RUNNER72: 25% integer shares at2R; remaining runner with2R trailing activated at2R; pending-stop queue preserves received updates; max72h.

future_error_budget.future_round_rule: alpha_k=.05/2**k for prospective validation round k>=1; independent unviewed seeds
future_error_budget.scope: Prospective validation program AFTER this checkpoint; no retroactive family confidence for historical trials.

gates.best_campaign_removal_scope: TREND and WEAK separately in each cost case; descriptive fixed-account subtraction, not resimulation
gates.label: N9S_1_INTERNAL_CONDITIONAL_ONLY
gates.null_positive_lower_scope: absolute and relative to same-cost CASH; both already included in40 endpoints
gates.tail_floor_unit: difference in mean terminal return fractions versus same-cost cash, separately by NULL/FALSE/GAP and cost

generator.null_distribution: conditionally compensated normal mixture; no trend or crash drift
generator.volume: positive intraday U-shape, activity, contemporaneous absolute return and independent noise; never future prices

limitations_locked_before_measurement: Synthetic equity-like symbols only; not observed AAPL/MSFT, not crypto/options.
OHLCV next-bar IOC and native cash ledger; no empirically calibrated order queue, rejects, market impact or entry partial fills.
Volume is tested in signals, not proof of executable market depth.
No holiday/DST simulation; supplied calendar scheduling and weekend exits are testable.
Native signal control, not the unintegrated virtual_net matrix coordinator.
NATIVE72 and FAST24 preserve legacy pending-stop replacement semantics. PROTECT48/RUNNER72 also repair queued receipt handling, so changes do not isolate exit-parameter alpha from that repair.
Independent seed holdout is conditional on this generator family, not market validation.
NULL substep prices are exact martingales, but OHLC threshold-fill interpolation is an additional approximation; positive absolute or cash-relative lower bounds block inference.
No automatic retraining, broker connection, deployment or trade authorization.
Momentum's daily standardized score does not treat5minute bars or correlated days as independent inference units.
A hard-continuous-exposure oracle bound is not a universal bound for the inherited admission-only cap or interpolated OHLC fills.
Queue-only ablations isolate receipt for identical native entry/risk/target/trailing parameters; momentum comparisons do not.
risk_semantics: 12% gross/name and0.25% risk are admission/reservation caps; market appreciation, gaps and equity drift may create post-entry ratio excesses. Report these separately; no continuous rebalance is assumed.

selection.final_if_no_positive_score: DO NOT OPEN RESERVED FINAL. Preserve negative development; no promotion.
pareto: mean nominal daily log across TREND/WEAK
p95 eventDD across all stress worlds
selection.risk_filter: max eventDD<=8%, worst session>=-2%, reconciled, signal-to-exit<=72h
selection.score: minimum over TREND/WEAK and nominal/stress of mean daily log minus1.645SE minus scenario hurdle
selection.tie_break: lower p95 stress drawdown, lower risk, lexical id

statistics.daily_denominator: inclusive calendar dates charged by native ledger
statistics.unit: independent full path; assets/costs/policies stay paired
